Persistence: page adapter, shared storage, server record store
|
|-- Page-owned WorkspacePersistence
|   |-- Per-session cursors + known drafts + subscriptions
|   |-- workspace.onPersist(ids) / SourcePaneViewState changes -> sync
|   |-- sync(ids) -> controller.persistenceChanges(cursor)
|   |   `-- History delta + metadata + baseline + personal view -> record batch
|   `-- -> storage.records.batch(): deduplicate unchanged content-addressed items
|-- Shared WorkspaceStorage (injected from App by default)
|   |-- records: RecordStorage (created by load())
|   |   |-- Cache + coalesced pending keys + one in-flight batch
|   |   |-- requestId + expectedRevision: retry identity and concurrency guard
|   |   `-- transport.write(batch) -> WorkspaceStorage worker request
|   |-- Worker + request/response correlation map
|   |   `-- workspaceStorage.worker.ts: encode -> POST /api/mapping/workspace/records
|   |-- load(): restore records/workspace -> page reconciles session seeds
|   |-- flush(): await RecordStorage acknowledgement
|   `-- dispose(): terminate worker; NOT a flush guarantee
`-- Server WorkspaceRecordStore (independent persistence boundary)
    |-- apply(): serialized per storage root
    |   |-- Check retry receipt, then expected workspace revision
    |   |-- Validate record updates; revisions/items are immutable
    |   |-- Checkpoint re-encoding may change; semantic content must not
    |   `-- Publish content-addressed JSON -> atomic manifest replacement
    `-- Manifest: record references + workspace revision + durable retry receipt
